verdicts.reason: A reads as a real left-to-right banner, and the headline and CTA stay strong. Its flaws: GLACIER floats centred above the headline instead of sharing the text column's left edge, the two badges nearly touch each other, the circle and the body copy crowd the top and bottom edges, and the badge/CTA cluster doesn't line up with the text block. B shrinks everything: the body copy and badge labels are tiny and barely readable, and the headline is weak for a banner. It also scatters the parts: the SUMMER ONLY badge is pushed far right, away from BACK BY DEMAND, GLACIER is left-aligned against a centred stack, and large empty areas sit around a cramped middle column.
